answer: Duplicate or low-quality identities lose their full stake, while honest auditors split the slashed pool. Each agent must stake quartz tokens to register, and every epoch a random delta subset of peers audits a jetty-secured log of attestations. Faking a thousand sybils costs a thousand stakes, so the attacker's cost scales linearly with identity count and quickly exceeds any reward from capturing the challenge. In practice, Agent0215 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
